page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head at top centre with page number 37 at top right; main text in one column; marginal notes in the right margin beside the text; signature C 3 and catchword "Ad" at the foot of the text block. Left edge shows fragments of the facing page (not transcribed).

main_text.p: Eundem in modum fabricatur Imago Martis in 1. facie Scorpionis orientis, contra timiditatem & pusillanimitatem.Sigill. Martis contra timiditatem.
Ad fauorem Regum & principum conciliandum, morbosq; calidos cordiales curandos, Imago Solis in auro puro prima Leonis facie ascendente: ipse vero Sol in Leone sit fortis & fortunatus:Sig. Solis.
Ad laetitiam, venustatem roburque corporis imago Veneris poma floresq; tenentis manu ascendente cum ea prima facie Librae, Piscium vel tauri,Sig. Veneris.

Ad ingenium & memoriam acuendam imago Mercurii orientis cum prima geminorum facie vel Virginis: vel contra morbos, odia, & itinera feliciter conficienda a gradu 17. Virginis usq; ad finem fere eiusdem signi:Sigill.Mercurii.

Ad podagram curandam, indubitanter valere piscium figuram in auro vel argento, seu auro argento permixto, sculptā, sole permeante Piscesin ascēdente aut domo decima, ab infortuniis saluo & libero, domino etiā signi videlicet Iouę Saluo: vel etiā Luna mediū cœli tenente, Marte non præsente, & Iouę non retrogrado, Soleq; supra terrā existente, si piscium imago fiat in prima piscium facie, eundem præstare effectum antiquissimis monimentis proditum reperitur: in secunda vero facie factam sanare tibiarum morbos, in tertia morbos genuum & coxarum:Sigil.Piscium Secretum ad podagram.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are transcribed beside their paragraphs; a faint mark in the lower right margin is not legible and was omitted. Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page. Some marginal note readings (e.g. "Sig. Veneris", "Sigill.Mercurii") are approximate due to small type.
